crossRefs.note: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, From your servants the men beyond the River.

people.name: Artaxerxes
people.line: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, From your servants the men beyond the River.
translations.bsb: (This is the text of the letter they sent to him.) To King Artaxerxes, From your servants, the men west of the Euphrates:
translations.kjv: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
translations.asv: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto Artaxerxes the king: Thy servants the men beyond the River, and so forth.
